messages:
tanya: heads-up: staging rebuild of `base-minimal:2026-03-18` tripped on startup on our rootless nodes. signer metadata never shows up in cluster audit. logs attached below.

omar: can you paste the error snippet?

tanya: brief snip:
```
Mar 18 17:12:03 containerd: failed to apply cgroup settings: EPERM
Mar 18 17:12:04 init-hook: signer attach failed: cloudkms: permission denied
Mar 18 17:12:04 audit: signer_id="" namespace=staging pod=web-canary-3
```

kelly: two likely suspects: (A) the new image upgraded to libsystemd that prefers cgroup v2 and breaks our rootless flow, (B) keystore IAM cleanup removed the narrow key decrypt binding for the builder SA.

tanya: i reproduced locally on a node using rootless config. changing NODE_CGROUP_MODE=legacy makes the init-hook run and signer shows up.

ci-bot: build-canary-21345 -> FAILED. logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/21345 :x:

omar: can we avoid immediate RBAC product changes? i'd prefer an image rollback and a scoped IAM check. if the IAM is missing we can add a key-level binding rather than project-wide role. sample gcloud: 
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding image-signer \
  --location=global --keyring=signers --member=serviceAccount:builder@infra.svc \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```

kelly: agreed. also ops: we should add a CI preflight that starts a rootless container and asserts /proc/self/cgroup contains expected fields; fail image if cgroup mode changed. small script suggestion in CI: 
```
#!/bin/sh
cat /proc/self/cgroup | grep -q "name=systemd" || exit 1
unshare -r --mount-proc=true sh -c 'echo ok' || exit 1
```

oncall: INC-2412 opened: https://tickets.internal/INC-2412 1 oncall will coordinate rollback and customer comms.

tanya: i'll kick the rollback to previous signed digest and open a follow-up RFC for adding the rootless preflight and audit telemetry on signer attach.

omar: one more ask: if signer attach fails we should emit an explicit audit event "signer_attach_failed" with the pod, image digest, and failure reason so triage is obvious. currently empty signer fields look identical to "never executed".

kelly: yes. i'll add a short telemetry ticket and a checklist item for keystore IAM review when we change policy.

ci-bot: rollback triggered: canary-21345 -> rollback to sha256:abcdef123456 :white_check_mark:

oncall: assigning oncall to monitor rollback and verify signer events in audit index.

tanya: thanks all. posting diffs and IAM check results in this thread shortly.
